about: check-size.mts --budgets: gzip bytes the browser downloads, per class, from dist/ after npm run build. JS is measured with Vite's 8-character chunk hashes replaced by a fixed string, so renaming a chunk does not move the totals. A size over its budget fails; a size more than 5% under fails until the budget is lowered, so budgets only go down.
